blocks.text: Computed Tomography, jise aam taur par CT-Scan kehte hain, medical imaging ka tareeqa hai jo X-ray technology ko computer processing se jor kar jism ke andar ki banawat ki bohat saaf (high-resolution) cross-sectional (aar-paar kati hui) aur 3D tasveerein banata hai. Yeh bimariyon ki pehchan, andar ki choton ka pata lagane aur ilaj ki rehnumai ke liye khaas taur par mufeed hai. Aam X-ray jism ki chapti (2D) tasveer deti hai jis mein haddiyan aur aza ek doosre ke oopar aa jate hain, is liye alag alag hisse saaf nahi dikhte. Maslan Fig. 20.7 (seene ki X-ray) mein aage aur peeche ki pasliyan (ribs) alag pehchanna mushkil hai kyunke woh ek doosre ke oopar nazar aati hain. Is mushkil ka hal CT scan hai.

CT scanner jism ke ek hi hisse ki mukhtalif zawiyon (angles) se bohat si X-ray tasveerein leta hai. Computer in ko jor kar jism ki ek tafseeli cross-sectional (slice, qash) tasveer banata hai. Phir scanner jism ke saath thora aage khisak kar agle slice ke liye yahi amal dohrata hai. Aakhir mein computer tamam slices ko jor kar andar ki banawat ki 3D tasveer banata hai.

blocks.caption: Figure 20.8: CT scanner ka amal (kitab ki Figure 20.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki shakal mein 'gamma ray' aur 'gamma ray detectors' likha hai aur ring ke dono taraf surkh detectors hain. CT mein gamma rays nahi, X-rays istemal hoti hain: aik taraf X-ray tube aur saamne detector hota hai, aur tube mareez ke gird ghoomti hai. Isi liye hum ne 'X-ray', 'X-ray detectors' aur neeche 'X-ray tube' dikhaya hai.
Kitab ke mutabiq CT machine mein X-ray tube mareez ke gird ghoomti hai jab ke detectors apni jagah rehte hain, aur is tarah har taraf se poori maloomat jama hoti hai (Fig. 20.8).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab ka bayan ek design (detectors ki fixed ring) ka hai. Zyada tar jadeed CT scanners mein detectors bhi X-ray tube ke saamne wali taraf us ke saath ghoomte hain. Dono soorton mein asal baat ek hai: X-rays har zawiye se jism ke aar-paar naapi jati hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: CT-scanner Sir Godfrey Hounsfield (England) aur Allan Cormack (South Africa) ne 1970 ki dahai ke shuru mein banaya. Is ijad par dono ko 1979 mein Physiology or Medicine ka Nobel Prize mila.

items: Computed: computer data process karta hai.
Tomography: Greek lafz tomos se, jis ka matlab hai slice (qash, patli tah).
Axial: scan jism ke axis (jism ke beech se guzarti lakeer) ke saath liya jata hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: CT-scan seconds mein saikron slices (tasveerein) bana leta hai, jaise digital seb ko tah dar tah chheela ja raha ho. CT-scan stroke (falij) ko shuru hone ke chand minute mein pakar sakta hai, jo jaan bachane wale ilaj ke liye bohat zaroori hai.

Is tarah doctors andar ke aza, haddiyon ya tissues ka saaf aur tafseeli manzar dekhte hain. Fig. 20.9 mein ek bachche ka CT scan ho raha hai aur monitor par sar ki cross-sectional tasveer hai. Is tareeqe ko Computed Axial Tomography (CT scan) kehte hain kyunke computer scanning ko control karta, data jama karta aur use tasveeron mein badalta hai. X-ray tube mareez ke jism ke gird ghoom kar mukhtalif zawiyon se tasveerein leti hai, jin se jism ke tafseeli cross-sectional slices bante hain. Lafz "tomography" Greek lafz tomos (slice) se hai, jo batata hai ke jism ki tasveer tah dar tah banti hai.

CT scans aam X-rays ke muqable mein kai aham faide dete hain. Akeli X-ray tasveer jaldi banti aur mufeed hai, lekin sirf chapta, do-rukhi (2D) manzar deti hai. CT scans teen-rukhi (3D) tasveerein dete hain jin se doctors jism ke andar aza, haddiyon aur doosri banawaton ka size, shakal aur theek jagah dekh sakte hain. Is se milti julti density wale tissues bhi alag pehchane ja sakte hain. Maslan CT scan rasoli (tumour) ki jagah aur size saaf dikha sakta hai, jis se ilaj mein high-energy X-rays ya gamma rays ka nishana theek lagaya ja sakta hai. Lekin yaad rahe ke CT scan mein X-rays istemal hoti hain jo ionizing radiation hain; radiation ki miqdar nisbatan kam hai magar mareez ke liye thora khatra phir bhi hai. CT scan ki khurak (dose) scan ki qism par munhasir hai: sar ka CT taqreeban 2 mSv (qudrati background radiation ke taqreeban 8 mahine) aur seene ya pet ka CT taqreeban 7-10 mSv (taqreeban 2-3 saal). Is liye doctors khaas ehtiyat karte hain, khaas taur par hamila khawateen aur pehle se bimar mareezon ke scan mein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke CT scan ki ausat khurak saal bhar ki qudrati background shua ki aik tihai, ya chaar lambi hawai parwazon ke barabar hai. Asal khurak kahin zyada hai: sar ka CT taqreeban 2 mSv aur seene ya pet ka 7-10 mSv, jab ke saal bhar ki background taqreeban 2.4-3 mSv aur aik lambi parwaz sirf 0.03-0.1 mSv deti hai. Kitab ke dono muqable aapas mein bhi nahi milte. Isi liye CT sirf tab use hota hai jab us ka faida thore khatre se zyada ho.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: CT scanners mukhtalif zawiyon se bohat si X-ray tasveerein le kar jism ka ek 2D cross-section banate hain. Jab yeh slices jore jate hain to cake ki tahon ki tarah ek 3D model ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt: CT scan aam X-ray mein chhupi rasoli kaise dikha sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Aam X-ray har raaste par har cheez ki jazbiyat jor deti hai, is liye banawatein aik doosre par chadh jati hain; CT qash ko bohat se zawiyon se napta aur computer qash ke har nuqte ki jazbiyat dobara banata hai, jis se oopar neeche ki banawatein aur density ke chhote farq alag ho jate hain.

items: CT: X-ray tube mareez ke gird ghoom kar har zawiye se tasveer leti hai; computer 2D slices bana kar 3D mein jorta hai.
Naam: Computed, Tomography (tomos = slice), Axial; Hounsfield aur Cormack (Nobel 1979).
Faide: 3D manzar, ek doosre par chadhi banawatein alag, rasoli ki jagah aur size.
X-rays ionizing hain: CT ki dose aam X-ray se kaafi zyada, is liye ehtiyat.
